defect_register.title: io_append validation logs rows as 'rejected' but appends them anyway; retry scripts then re-append -> 9 duplicate pairs
defect_register.evidence: work/io_append.py problems-list logic (non-numeric -> appended with logging); extraction_log rows_rejected_at_append for 2f8abcf1-046/047 while those row_ids exist in CSV; 9 duplicate pairs (046/061,047/062,073/077,094/098,116/119,117/120,118/121,130/150,182/185)
defect_register.rows_affected: 9 later-id rows duplicate_measurement; dataset 188 rows -> 179 unique measurements
defect_register.remediation: make validation failure actually skip the append (continue/return), dedupe rows, add idempotency key (doi+sample+condition) checked before append

defect_register.title: filler_loading_wt_pct stores formulation parts (not wt%) for all 20 polym13060955 rows
defect_register.evidence: paper text: '70% by weight of BN with respect to the combined weight of epoxy and BN' AND 'samples with 58.0 wt.% BN'; rows carry 60/70/65 in wt_pct with correct vol% (34.2/44.7/38.1/43.3)
defect_register.rows_affected: a9d63e6e-010..029 (20 rows; 3 of them also cross-paper duplicates)
defect_register.remediation: recompute wt% from paper Table (58.0/47.x) or move parts value to filler_loading_original_value + unit 'phr-equivalent'

defect_register.title: Cross-paper duplicated measurements (companion/citing papers) - 5 pairs
defect_register.evidence: a9d63e6e-014/015/016 (3.34/4.77/7.67, ETLBN30-70) identical to d831a829-135/136/138 (polym13020286 Table 1 S1/S2/S4, same group, same samples, both papers present in fulltext); a8b6fee9-141/142 (0.352/0.364) are 'previous work by our group' citations of e5a9c8bd-122/123 (mi16040413)
defect_register.rows_affected: 10 rows marked duplicate_measurement (both sides); drop a9d63e6e-014/015/016 and a8b6fee9-141/142 (also policy violations: README excludes literature-comparison values)
defect_register.remediation: drop the 5 recommended rows; add cross-paper value+sample fingerprint dedup

defect_register.title: QC report claims 'unit normalization: normalize_k() applied' - function is never called
defect_register.evidence: grep: normalize_k defined only; 2/26 unit tests FAIL on fallback path (kW/mK unscaled, uW silently accepted)
defect_register.remediation: wire normalize_k into append_rows OR correct the QC claim; fix kW/muW fallback before any future non-W unit enters

defect_register.title: 11 of 63 paper_title values are not the title of their own DOI (verified against Crossref)
defect_register.evidence: e.g. 10.1038/s41598-018-19945-3 actual 'Enhanced Thermal Conductivity of PI Composites with BNNS' vs dataset 'In-plane and out-of-plane...'; 10.1039/c8ra10211b actual 'Improved dielectric stability of epoxy composites with ultralow boron nitride loading' vs dataset '3D BN/PA66 aerogel scaffolds...'; full list in work/audit_phase1_rows.json findings; wrong titles propagate to paper_inventory.csv and extraction_log.csv
defect_register.rows_affected: all rows of the 11 DOIs (~30 rows) carry wrong paper_title; DOI/k/source_location verified CORRECT
defect_register.remediation: re-fetch titles from Crossref/EPMC and overwrite paper_title in all three files

defect_register.title: 3 rows mislabel the measured sample
defect_register.evidence: fa7ce3db-036 filler='BN' for (CuNPs-CuNWs)@BN/PI hybrid (README requires 'hybrid' label); 3bde4e56-147 filler='cBN' with 0.0 wt% (neat-matrix baseline); 544349ee-180 filler='AlN' but paper is trimodal Al2O3+BN ('AlN' 0 hits in fulltext)
defect_register.remediation: fix filler_material; label hybrid/co-filler rows per README convention (rows 151/152/153/188/095 also non-conforming but documented in notes)

defect_register.title: Row b639a9c9-159 k=1.052 does not occur in its fulltext
defect_register.evidence: 0 hits for '1.052'/'1.05' in 10.3390/ma18215011.txt; consistent with 1.278/1.214=1.0527 derivation from stated +21.4% or Figure-5 digitization (log: figures inspected 'TC figures'); source_location presents it as a direct Results value
defect_register.remediation: either disclose derivation/digitization in source_location+value_source='figure', or drop the row

defect_register.title: Literature-comparison values present despite README exclusion policy
defect_register.evidence: a8b6fee9-141/142 (cited previous-work values, also cross-paper dups); 4a11b03c-151 k=0.54 explicitly 'According to our previous work' in nano8120997
defect_register.remediation: drop 141/142/151 or re-source to original DOIs

defect_register.title: Non-numeric values in numeric fields (2 true violations + 7 unparsable loading strings)
defect_register.evidence: numeric-column violations: filler_mean_size_um '55 (AlN) / 35 (BN)' (130); measurement_temperature_C 'RT' (094). unparsable strings in text column filler_loading_original_value: '30 wt% BNNS + 1 wt% BNNT' (046/047), '20 wt% BNNS + 2 wt% G-POSS' (073), '30 AlN + 2 Ni' (116/117/118), '30-4' (182) - log claims rejections that did not happen
defect_register.rows_affected: 9 rows (2 numeric-column violations + 7 unparsable original-value strings)
defect_register.remediation: fix the 2 numeric cells; split the 7 strings into value+detail columns; make validation authoritative (reject-and-skip)

defect_register.title: 3 screened papers excluded without appearing in unusable_sources.csv or extraction_log
defect_register.evidence: 10.3390/polym11101548 (wave2_screen n_k=2, both literature-comparison), 10.3390/polym15051214 (n_k=0), 10.3390/nano13152243 (screen_report, candidates) - fulltext on disk, zero rows, absent from both outputs
defect_register.remediation: add exclusion rows to unusable_sources.csv with reasons; verify polym11101548 truly has no own-data k values

defect_register.title: Assorted per-row defects on verified values
defect_register.evidence: 2f8abcf1-046/047 curing_agent 100:38 vs source 100:35 (+notes typo LY654 vs LY564); 2a7dd240-105 k_direction='through-plane' unsupported (paper: follows in-plane model) + vol 6.32 vs table 6.33; caf49a8d-129 neat-epoxy row retained; 0ab9ce56-184 source paper internally inconsistent BN60 vs BN70 attribution; schema columns filler_aspect_ratio+size_distribution 100% empty
defect_register.remediation: fix field values; drop or fill empty columns

defect_register.title: Exclusion decisions hardcoded, search_log written retrospectively
defect_register.evidence: unusable DOIs absent from extraction_log.jsonl (only in build_deliverables.py); search_log.json mtime after deliverables; 5/48 unusable DOIs not in candidates.json; 3 IOP 'PDFs' are Radware captcha HTML (correctly listed unusable)
defect_register.remediation: log exclusion decisions at screening time with reason codes
